name: Home Fries
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 3 medium potatoes (e.g., russet or Yukon gold), peeled and diced

steps: Boil diced potatoes in salted water for 5 minutes to soften slightly. Drain and let them dry.
Heat oil or butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Add onions (and peppers if using), sauté until translucent.
Add the potatoes in a single layer. Let them brown undisturbed for 5–6 minutes.
Flip and cook the other sides until golden and crispy.
Season with salt, pepper, and paprika. Serve hot.
